headline: Man United stunned by late Tottenham equaliser as 10-men visitors move off bottom of PL table
description: A below-par Manchester United were denied a morale-boosting win by 10-man Tottenham on Saturday as Dominic Solanke scored in stoppage time to lift the visitors off the bottom of the Premier League table.

headline: Fulham boss Alvaro Arbeloa on Premier League pressure: I don't feel fear, I coached Real Madrid
description: Alvaro Arbeloa bristled at suggestions he cannot handle the pressure after Fulham's 2-1 loss at Ipswich extended their winless run in the Premier League to six matches.

headline: Xabi Alonso lauds Chelsea hero Jordan Henderson after brace in Bournemouth thrashing
description: Xabi Alonso admitted goalscoring was not high on his list of reasons for signing Jordan Henderson after the veteran's two-goal display against Bournemouth.

headline: Premier League recap: Man United, Spurs settle for draw in can't-lose matchup
description: Neither Man United nor Spurs could afford to lose their Saturday meeting, and after some back and forth, neither did. Relive the day's action with ESPN.

headline: Riccardo Calafiori channels David Beckham with Arsenal goal in England vs. Greece anniversary boots
description: Arsenal's Riccardo Calafiori can lay claim to a unique first after his goal against Leeds United at the Emirates on Saturday.

headline: '51 years': Man United fans revive Man City 'trophy drought' banner after financial charges verdict
description: Manchester United fans reset the clock on their Stretford End 'ticker' on Saturday to make clear their views on how Manchester City should be punished for breaching the Premier League's financial rules.
